Clear 2K resolution with a 351° panoramic view, 60° tilt and 4× zoom, plus a split screen to watch two babies at once, day or night. The camera must stay plugged in to operate.

A stable local feed works without Wi-Fi, while remote access keeps you connected when you are away, and viewing can be shared with up to 5 family members. Please update the app to version V5.6.0 or above before use.
A 5000mAh high-capacity battery gives up to 12 hours of screen time on a single charge. Battery life is based on internal lab testing and actual performance may vary.

An advanced sensing system continually monitors your baby's kicks, rolls and cries along with room temperature and unusual noises. Customisable alert settings reduce distractions so you only get the updates that matter.

A reliable local connection, one-tap Wi-Fi off in the app and RSA-1024 with AES-128 encryption keep monitoring private, with each recording stored locally. The SD card is not included and its slot sits underneath the camera lens.
